# Psalm 116 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** I-love, for hears YHWH my-voice, my-supplications.

**2** For he-has-inclined his-ear to-me, and-in-my-days I-will-call.

**3** Surrounded-me the-cords-of death, and-the-straits-of Sheol found-me; distress and-sorrow I-found.

**4** And-on-name-of YHWH I-called: 'O YHWH deliver my-soul!'

**5** Gracious YHWH and-righteous, and-our-God is-compassionate.

**6** Keeper-of the-simple YHWH; I-was-brought-low and-to-me he-saved.

**7** Return O-my-soul to-your-rest, for YHWH has-dealt-bountifully with-you.

**8** For you-have-delivered my-soul from-death, my-eye from-tears, my-foot from-stumbling.

**9** I-will-walk before YHWH in-lands-of the-living.

**10** I-believed, for I-will-speak; I was-afflicted greatly.

**11** I said in-my-alarm, 'All mankind liars.'

**12** What shall-I-return to-YHWH for-all his-benefits upon-me?

**13** The-cup-of salvations I-will-lift, and-on-name-of YHWH I-will-call.

**14** My-vows to-YHWH I-will-pay, please before all his-people.

**15** Precious in-eyes-of YHWH the-death of-his-faithful-ones.

**16** O YHWH for I your-servant; I your-servant son-of your-maidservant; you-have-loosed my-bonds.

**17** To-you I-will-sacrifice a-sacrifice-of thanksgiving, and-on-name-of YHWH I-will-call.

**18** My-vows to-YHWH I-will-pay, please before all his-people,

**19** In-courts-of house-of YHWH, in-your-midst O-Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **116:15**: 'Precious in-eyes-of YHWH the-death of-his-faithful-ones' — not that God delights in death, but that the death of his saints is costly/weighty to him; he does not treat it lightly.

- **116:13**: 'Cup-of salvations' (kos yeshu'ot) — a liturgical act; raising the cup in thanksgiving, paralleling the Passover cup.

— EMET
